proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hAB h hiso
  have e := (EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two B A C).mpr h
  rw [dist_comm B A, dist_comm C A, ← hiso] at e
  have hb := EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_angle_of_dist_eq hiso
  have hs := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi C hAB.symm
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm B C A, ← hb, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C A B, h] at hs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (mul_self_inj dist_nonneg (by positivity)).mp ?_
    have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
    rw [e]
    linear_combination (-(dist A B * dist A B)) * h2
  · linarith
  · linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), A ≠ B → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 2 → dist A B = dist A C → dist B C = Real.sqrt 2 * dist A B ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = Real.pi / 4 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle A C B = Real.pi / 4
